say:1:1621740101:1.text: This is too bizarre! Is it even possible for someone to change so much in a month?
say:1:1621740101:1.source_cn: 这也太奇怪了吧！人真的能在一个月内发生这么大的变化吗？

say:2:1621740102:1.text: No one could pull that off—not even a genius!
say:2:1621740102:1.source_cn: 不可能有人在短时间内变成完全相反的样子，就算是天才也不行啊！

say:3:1621740103:1.text: Other issues aside, magic can't change someone's ability to carry a tune.
say:3:1621740103:1.source_cn: 别的暂且不说，五音不全是很难改变的，连魔法也做不到这件事。

say:4:1621740104:1.text: Could Girod... have lied to us? Why would he do that?
say:4:1621740104:1.source_cn: 难道……难道他是在骗我们？应该不会吧，谁会在这种事情上...

say:5:1621740105:1.text: There's no point in guessing. Let's head straight to the <style="highlight">library</style> and confront Girod.
say:5:1621740105:1.source_cn: 猜也猜不出结果，我们直接去<style=highlig...
